simple.meaning: רָעָה (râʻâh) appears 164 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and as a keeper of sheep and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Judges, 1 Samuel, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 4:2. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as birth, family, family line, shepherding, flock, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָעָה (H7462) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows רָעָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: רָעָה (râʻâh) / H7462 is tracked through Genesis 4:2, Genesis 29:7, Genesis 29:9, Genesis 30:31. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
